execution: None: names and source branches are evidence only; existing test files were copied but not executed.

limitations.detail: Host reports 1.95.0 while audited stable scope is 1.141.0. Raising the number is not an implementation fix.
Extension registrations plus finite NATIVE_COMMANDS only; native delegation accepts no arguments. No complete execute-provider/original command protocol.
File path/file URI only; content/untitled overload and custom schemes reject. Multi-root resources and filesystem providers absent.

Active group only; positional view-column overload, preview true, preserveFocus true reject even though newer native editor features exist. Mirror/editor handle is document keyed rather than exact group membership.
Returns active editor only. Independent shared-document group views, tabGroups and visible/selection/options/range events are absent.
Selection getter only (no setter); no options, visibleRanges, viewColumn, revealRange, decorations or insertSnippet. edit rejects undoStopBefore/After false.
replace/insert/delete only; setEndOfLine absent. Native transaction/version guard exists but overload and stop grouping require independent qualification.
save and getWordRangeAtPosition missing. Change notifications are full-document replacements; per-edit ranges/reasons, willSave and save participant orchestration are not provided.

Text-edit construction exists for code-action consumption; create/rename/delete file are recorded as unsupported and rejected; snippet/notebook/metadata operations and general workspace.applyEdit absent.
Method always rejects; native persistent settings implementation is not connected. Full resource/multi-root inspection and API target semantics need explicit review.

Subscriptions/path/URI/mode/extension/globalState/workspaceState exist; secrets, storage/log paths, environment-variable collections and languageModelAccessInformation missing. Global state cloud synchronization rejects.
Notification without choices only; items/options/modal branches reject.
No supplied cancellation tokens, multi-pick, ignoreFocusOut, validation/password options, advanced items, buttons or stateful createQuickPick/createInputBox.

Eight registrations: completion, hover, definition, references, document formatting, symbols, signature, code actions. Other families, match/getLanguages/setTextDocumentLanguage/setLanguageConfiguration absent; selector supports language/scheme only.

Resolution exists but commands, commitCharacters, keepWhitespace reject; insert/replace pairs, selector pattern and complete metadata not implemented. DTO writable fields are not proof of native consumption.

Direct/lazy text edit handling exists with bounded retained original object identity; command-bearing actions and unsupported workspace operations reject; documentation metadata rejects. This is not complete command execution/applyEdit semantics.
Provider result locations require local file URI. Virtual/remote/notebook/custom schemes cannot retain location behavior.

Collection-local behaviors have existing reference evidence; aggregate empty-resource bookkeeping and full lifecycle remain qualified only by their named scope. Shared read/edit identity, counts and normalization must remain guarded.

Markdown HTML/trust rejected by provider normalization. SnippetString public builders including callback placeholders/variables/choices now exist in source, while native nested navigation/choice UI/variables/TextEditor.insertSnippet remain outstanding. Uri strict flag and several URI edge semantics remain unqualified.
Text channels exist; log:true overload/LogOutputChannel logging, severity and events not implemented.
Limited plain-text tooltip, colors and backgrounds; accessibilityInformation and rich latest options absent.
Contributed single-selection bounded trees; reveal rejects; no getParent/resolveTreeItem, drag/drop, checkboxes or full item icons/context/menu semantics.
Owner activation/dependencies/registry exist; cross-host lookup and browser/remote extension placement remain unqualified/unsupported.

additional_absent_domains_in_present_nam: all omitted language providers/semantic tokens/inlay hints/folding/selection/call/type hierarchy/drop/paste/notebook support
compatibility_method: Every overload and result/input field needs semantic fixtures and native integrity/lifecycle tests. Missing or rejecting APIs remain explicit; stubs or Proxy removal do not satisfy the contract. Optional compatibility host stays isolated from native core editing.
